description: This file contains utility functions, class definitions, and React hooks related to managing list views, filters, sorting, pagination, and URL query parameters in a React application, specifically for a component in the Superset frontend.

classes.name: ListViewError
classes.description: Custom error class for list view related errors.

methods.name: removeFromList
methods.description: Removes an element from a list at a specified index, returning a new list.

methods.name: updateInList
methods.description: Updates an element in a list at a specified index with new data, returning a new list.

methods.name: mergeCreateFilterValues
methods.description: Merges filter list with an update object to produce updated filter values.

methods.name: convertFilters
methods.description: Converts internal filter objects to data filter values for API consumption.

methods.name: convertFiltersRison
methods.description: Converts decoded Rison filter object and filter list into filter values.

methods.name: extractInputValue
methods.description: Extracts value from input event based on input type.

methods.name: useListViewState
methods.description: React hook managing list view state including filters, sorting, pagination, and URL query parameters.
